critique.summary: Clean, correct, brand-aligned pipeline-coverage data slide. Prior blockers resolved in rendered pixels: all four stage tiles render identically (equal 410x136 rounded rects, matching 1px #E5E7EB borders, equal teal top rules, even 450px pitch, no overlaps), stage_2 ($21.4M Qualification) present, hero right side filled by paired $18M target block (no dead zone). Hierarchy unambiguous: 4.2x (128px teal) dominates, $18M (64px) mid-tier, stage values (40px) subordinate, labels/footer smallest. Contrast clean throughout. No imagery per brief. Single teal accent family, Inter, white background. Only benign font embed/subset export warnings remain.

issues.message: Tall-ish empty band between hero takeaway (~y525) and stage tiles (y673); reads as intentional breathing room, could optionally be tightened.
issues.suggested_repair: Optional: raise stages row ~40-60px to even vertical rhythm; not required for acceptance.

acceptance_notes: Alignment: shared 80px margins and left spine at x80; consistent 24px inset in tiles.
Spacing: four tiles evenly spaced 450px pitch, no overlaps.
Hierarchy: squint test passes, 4.2x single focal point.
Contrast: teal figures and #4B5563 text on white all legible.
Clipping: all figures sit inside 410px tiles.
Request+Brand: matches data-slide type at 1920x1080, clear figures, exactly one takeaway, no imagery, single teal accent + Inter + white bg.
Prior issues verified resolved: tile borders consistent across all four, stage_2 present, hero dead zone filled.
